calculation.description: Ranks 20-day price momentum only when lagged volume is above its prior 20-observation median; the logarithmic participation surprise limits extreme volume effects. All inputs are lagged or completed-day observations at decision time.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across 2020-2022 (IC 0.05194, ICIR 0.14039), 2023-2024 (IC 0.01305, ICIR 0.03595), and 2025-2026 (IC 0.03802, ICIR 0.10659). The middle regime is weaker; uncertainty is material because the cross-section is only 15 assets.
